description: Create a SimplifyQA release in the connected project — what Releases → Create Release does — and return its key (RE-xx). Needs `name`, `plannedStartDate`, `plannedEndDate` (YYYY-MM-DD) and `estimatedEffort` (hours). The state defaults to New and the owner to the connected user (SimplifyQA requires one). A release with the same name is refused. It reads the release back. Only an admin user can create releases. Use the returned RE-xx as `releaseId` for runs, schedules and pipelines, and create sprints with sprint_create.

owners.description: Owners: emails, names, user ids or "me". Default: the connected user (SimplifyQA requires at least one owner).

plannedEndDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD, on or after the start.

state.description: Defaults to the project's first state (New). An unknown state is refused with the valid ones listed.

name: release_create
title: Create a release (SimplifyQA)
